description: This file defines a class 'TerminationSignalWatcher' that manages system signal handling for termination signals (SIGTERM, SIGINT). It installs signal handlers to gracefully shut down the application, logs the signal receipt, stops pairing prompts, terminates the app, and sets a safety timer to force exit if needed.

classes.name: TerminationSignalWatcher
classes.description: A singleton class that listens for termination signals (SIGTERM, SIGINT) and handles cleanup and shutdown procedures in a macOS application.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes signal handlers for SIGTERM and SIGINT if not already active.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Removes all installed signal handlers and resets the termination request flag.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Sets up a signal handler for a specified signal number, ignoring the default, and creating a DispatchSource to handle it.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the received termination signal by logging, stopping pairing prompts, terminating the app, and scheduling a forced exit if needed.
